description_en: Obtains tables of different data source types within a tenant by page
description_zh: 分页获取租户下面的数据源类型粒度的表名称
name: ListTables

parameters.help_en: The number of entries displayed on each page. The default value is 10 and the maximum value is 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为 10 条，最大为 100 条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The type of the data source. Valid values: ODPS, emr, mysql, holo, analyticdb_for_mysql, oracle, postgresql, sqlserver, clickhouse, and starrocks
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型。支持取值为odps、
emr、
mysql、
holo、
analyticdb_for_mysql、
oracle、
postgresql、
sqlserver、
clickhouse、
starrocks
parameters.name: data_source_type

parameters.help_en: Pagination information, which specifies the starting point of this read
parameters.help_zh: 分页信息，指定本次读取的起始点
parameters.name: next_token
